title: Regensburger Wappen- und Porträtbücher (Band 06, Vormundamt: edited text)
author: Officials of the Regensburg guardianship office (Vormundamt)
institution: Zentrum für Informationsmodellierung, Universität Graz, with the Stadtarchiv Regensburg (EuroMACHS class of 2012; transcription by Carina Kargl)
notes: Twelve Regensburg office books of the 16th to early 19th century are shown as page images in the DFG-Viewer; only Band 06 (Wappen- und Porträtbuch des Vormundamtes, StAR I Aa 6) also has an edited text. It contains a preface (1649), the founding decree of 1537 and a list of directors, assessors and clerks from 1537 to 1787, with 64 portraits dated 1649 to c. 1751. The in-period count is ours, from the TEI file: about 8,100 words on the folios whose first year is 1700 or earlier (the whole transcription has about 11,700 words in the text body). The project dates from 2012 (TEI file dated 2012-03-29, site copyright 2012) and has no later update, so it is listed as archived.
